reviews.title: Persian Gulf aviation GNSS quality anomaly
reviews.reason: The GPSInterference.com report is based on ADS-B-derived estimates and not confirmed jamming. The robust Z-score of 1.11 and median change of 0.15 indicate a moderate anomaly, but the sample size of 38 is relatively small. The lack of corroboration and official alert suggests this is not a significant anomaly. The evidence is limited and the anomaly is not robust enough to warrant elevation.
